title: bug: local-runner seededAgents fixture assumes umask preserves group and other mode bits
description:
In an isolated Linux snapshot, `umask 077; node --test --test-name-pattern='AI[45] ' scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs` fails AI4 and AI5: seededAgents writes with mode 0555 but observes 0500, while OLD_AGENTS expects 0555.
The same rows pass under umask 022. Make the fixture explicitly establish its intended mode; production behavior is outside this finding.
definitionOfDone: AI4 and AI5 pass under both umask 077 and umask 022, with the existing production-mode assertions unchanged.
